title: The Nullifier's Companion
summary: A companion for the nullifier past the courses that adds the total negation of a field and the reversal that turns a hostile note home.

title: A Treatise on the Structure of Cancelling
summary: A treatise on the lattice of a soul technique and the strand that bears its weight so that cutting it cancels the whole.

title: Treatise of the Mirrored Opposites
summary: A treatise on setting a perfect mirror of opposites against a hostile note so that each of the pair cancels the other.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Quiet
summary: A manual of the hawk's quiet hover and the swift stoop of silence that falls on a hostile soul technique from above.

title: The Sworn Stillness Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the stillness sworn on the wind in which the soul stays unmoved by any force and stands without cover.

title: Treatise on the Bearing of Quiet
summary: A treatise on taking the bearing of a hostile soul force and holding a quiet heading until the force drifts away.
